# gramlot-py-server 0.2.8

- Serve the root-page manifest with GET/HEAD across Uvicorn, Django, Flask, FastAPI and Kajenn.
- Use the shared index gallery and updated examples; retain quick starts in server documentation.
- Align the Kajenn guide and authentication tests with its existing identity API.
- Require the core and examples versions used by the integrated gallery.

Qualification: 92 adapter tests, including HTTP conformance, authentication and manifests, with Kajenn 0.5.0. Chromium covers the Python gallery interactions and remote page lifecycle. No new production deployment or OS installation claim is made.
